findings.title: Stop-file clearing has no test on the runner wiring
findings.description: The new `clearStale(s, 'agent-run')` call in `agent()` and the `clearStale(s, 'reopen')` call in the reopen branch are not exercised by any test; the added unit test only asserts the return value of `staleFiles()`. Removing or misplacing either call would leave all 14 tests green while the original bug (a stale `stop.md` stopping the next run) returns.
